---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a mechanic, content, tooling or quality-of-life improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem or opportunity

What is missing, awkward or could be better? Describe the situation from the
player's or the contributor's point of view.

## Proposed change

What would you like to happen? Be concrete: which screen, which key, which
world, which numbers.

## Design notes

- Which of the design pillars does it serve? (one button is enough, skill
  first, every run matters, unlock options not numbers, short runs / long
  journey, death creates motivation)
- Can it be expressed as data (`src/main/resources/data/*.json`) rather than
  code?
- Does it affect determinism, balance or the save format?

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem and why they are less attractive.

## Additional context

Mock-ups, references, prior art.
